entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan Francisco "Juanfran" Pérez Llorca is a Spanish politician serving as president of the Valencian Government since November 2025 and as a member of the Corts Valencianes since 2023. He has served as secretary general of the People's Party of the Valencian Community since 2023, and as spokesperson of its group in the Corts since 2024. He served as mayor of Finestrat from 2015 to 2025.

entities.summary: Juan Francisco "Juanfran" Pérez Llorca is a Spanish politician serving as president of the Valencian Government since November 2025 and as a member of the Corts Valencianes since 2023. He has served as secretary general of the People's Party of the Valencian Community since 2023, and as spokesperson of its group in the Corts since 2024. He served as mayor of Finestrat from 2015 to 2025.
